extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures digitised: Figure 1 (temperature dependence of conversion, CH3OH and CH4 selectivity, methanol WTY), Figure 2 (time-on-stream conversion; first and last plotted points only), and Figure 6 (3D histogram of CO2 conversion versus Cu+/(Cu0+Cu+) ratio and temperature). Characterisation figures 3–5 were skipped. Figure 6 is a perspective 3D bar chart; values, especially for the Cu+/(Cu0+Cu+) = 0.68 series, are approximate.
